title: Simultaneous normalized exact realizations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. For every pointed connected qcqs topologically Noetherian scheme datum $(T,p)$ of [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data], one can simultaneously choose a normalized, fully faithful, additive, $E$-linear, lisse-valued exact rational realization $R(T,p)$, with its normalizations natural on every lattice-preserving map.

source.place: Definition 6.8.3, Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6), pp. 59–60, and the integral-monodromy reduction in the proof of Corollary 6.8.5, p. 60. The exact-realization formulation makes the comparison used in that proof explicit; it does not assert closure of all pro-étale lisse sheaves.

proof.text: For each T,p install connectedness from p and use [cor-galois-lisse-representations](1) to construct the finite correspondence c, without using its rational algebraically closed clause. For this c take J, full faithfulness, additivity, linearity, lisse values and functorial normalizations from [lem-sfb-normalized-monodromy-functor]. Apply [lem-sfb-normalized-monodromy-exact] to those same normalizations for the exactness field. Assemble SfMonodromyRealization and choose these simultaneously from the resulting Nonempty family.

proof_origin.place: Lean reduction of lem-sfb-etale-local-monodromy-realization; Simultaneous normalized exact realizations

theorem exists_sf_monodromy_realization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    Nonempty (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (p : SfMonodromyPoint T), SfMonodromyRealization l E p)
